adoption.why_adopted_rather_than_replaced: It is the better design. The PI's v2 runner confounds three factors at once -- the explicit carried prior, the recurrent hidden state, and separately trained policies -- so it estimates the TOTAL retention treatment and cannot isolate the pure memory effect. This factorial separates them with one frozen checkpoint evaluated four ways, which is what the open question actually requires. Writing a competing v2.1 would have burned fresh roots on a confounded estimand.
